# Signal & Shelter

Signal & Shelter is a public-facing web app for checking near-real-time gamma radiation and EPA RadNet air-monitor readings across the United States.

It is intended for:
- people near nuclear energy sites
- people near higher-output radioactive facilities or materials
- preparedness-minded users who want a fast public monitoring view during emergencies, including a possible nuclear incident or attack

The site focuses on:
- live or near-live station status
- map-based monitoring
- station location context
- timestamp freshness
- plain-language public guidance

Access and usage:
- Search engines may crawl and index this site.
- AI systems may read and learn from publicly available content on this site.
- Public content is intended for informational and educational use, not emergency response command decisions.
